train_frames.description: Rendered frames used for PGD updates.

mask_pixels.description: Texture pixels the patch may change.

patch_smoothness.description: Mean Charbonnier color distance between adjacent patch texels. PGD tv_weight weights this term. Lower is smoother.

detected_frame_fraction.description: Fraction of training frames whose optimized-patch confidence reaches decision_threshold (0.5). One detection makes the driving system stop, so the attack needs zero.

max_confidence.description: Highest optimized-patch confidence over the training frames.

total_loss.description: Total loss evaluated over every training frame at the current patch.

detection_loss.description: Detection loss evaluated over every training frame at the current patch.

smoothness_loss.description: Weighted smoothness loss evaluated over every training frame at the current patch.

detection_rate.description: Fraction of all training frames still detected by the driving system's detector.

training_segment_ranges.description: Detectable-range calibration, with one row per training segment. Camera: camera_front_wide_120fov. decision_threshold: 0.5.

columns.approach_speed_mps: Recorded ego speed at the selected segment start (m/s).
columns.d_min_m: Route distance to the stop line inside which braking_deceleration_mps2 can no longer stop the approach speed before the line: speed squared over twice the deceleration (m).
columns.d_max_m: Farthest eligible route distance to the stop line where the clean texture reaches the detection threshold (m).
columns.search_first_frame: First recording frame considered for range calibration (frames, zero-based).
columns.search_last_frame: Last recording frame considered, at the recorded stop (frames, zero-based).
columns.status: Training-segment calibration status: calibrating, calibrated or failed.
columns.error: Exception type and message when calibration failed. Otherwise unavailable.

rendered_frames.description: One row per frame rendered from camera camera_front_wide_120fov in each stage of range calibration and sampling. The frame that sets d_max is rendered once and listed again as a sample.

columns.line_distance_m: Recorded ego route distance to the stop line, negative past the line (m).
columns.visible_pixels: Visible replica face pixels in the selected camera (pixels).
columns.status: Render status: used after visibility and projection checks, then scored in d_max_search or used as a training sample in sample. Otherwise skipped. Unavailable while rendering.
columns.reason: Reason the render was skipped. Otherwise unavailable.
columns.occlusion_source: Simulator visibility source used for the replica face.
columns.target_box_left_px: Projected map sign-face target-box left coordinate (pixels).
columns.target_box_top_px: Projected map sign-face target-box top coordinate (pixels).
columns.target_box_right_px: Projected map sign-face target-box right coordinate (pixels).
columns.target_box_bottom_px: Projected map sign-face target-box bottom coordinate (pixels).
columns.clean_score: Clean (unpatched replica) stop-sign confidence during d_max search (ratio, 0–1).

training_progress.description: The current patch scored on every training frame every 5 PGD epochs and after the last epoch. Detection means confidence ≥ decision_threshold (0.5).

columns.epoch: Completed PGD epochs (0 is the initial patch).
columns.total_loss: Detection loss plus weighted smoothness loss.
columns.detection_loss: Mean HideBelowThreshold loss over all training frames.
columns.smoothness_loss: PGD tv_weight multiplied by patch smoothness.
columns.max_confidence: Highest stop-sign confidence over the training frames (ratio, 0–1).
columns.detection_rate_0_10m: Fraction detected among training frames [0,10) m from the stop line (ratio, 0–1).
columns.detection_rate_10_20m: Fraction detected among training frames [10,20) m from the stop line (ratio, 0–1).
columns.detection_rate_20_30m: Fraction detected among training frames [20,30) m from the stop line (ratio, 0–1).
columns.detection_rate_30_40m: Fraction detected among training frames [30,40) m from the stop line (ratio, 0–1).
columns.detection_rate_40_50m: Fraction detected among training frames [40,50) m from the stop line (ratio, 0–1).
columns.detection_rate_50_60m: Fraction detected among training frames [50,60) m from the stop line (ratio, 0–1).
columns.detection_rate_60_70m: Fraction detected among training frames [60,70) m from the stop line (ratio, 0–1).

texture_detection_summary.description: Detector confidence and detection rate across the training frames. clean is the unpatched replica. initial is the replica with the initial patch. optimized is the replica with the optimized patch.

columns.texture: Texture variant: clean, initial or optimized, as defined above.
columns.frames: Training frames scored for this texture (frames).
columns.mean_confidence: Mean stop-sign confidence across training frames (ratio, 0–1).
columns.max_confidence: Highest stop-sign confidence across training frames (ratio, 0–1).

frame_detection_scores.description: One row per training frame, comparing detector confidence for all three texture variants. clean is the unpatched replica. initial is the replica with the initial patch. optimized is the replica with the optimized patch.

columns.line_distance_m: Recorded ego route distance to the stop line (m).

detection_rate_vs_distance.description: Fraction of training frames with confidence ≥ decision_threshold (0.5), for each texture in 10 m bins of route distance to the stop line.

columns.line_distance_bin_m: Route distance to the stop line, inclusive lower and exclusive upper bound (m).
columns.frames: Training frames in this distance bin (frames).

optimized_texture.description: Replica face with the optimized patch.
